verdict.rationale: Whether user data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud file-storage service like OneDrive, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any related data-use control. The material covers only file access, sharing, sync, versioning and Graph APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
